lines.text: Drop hard plastic in water. What floats sells for more.
lines.phonemes: dɹˈɑːp hˈɑːɹd plˈæstɪk ɪn wˈɔːɾɚ. wˌʌt flˈoʊts sˈɛlz fɔːɹ mˈɔːɹ.

lines.text: Why would floating change the price?
lines.phonemes: wˌaɪ wʊd flˈoʊɾɪŋ tʃˈeɪndʒ ðə pɹˈaɪs?

lines.text: Floaters are polythene and polypropylene, lighter than water; PVC sinks.
lines.tts: Floaters are polythene and polypropylene, lighter than water; P V C sinks.
lines.phonemes: flˈoʊɾɚz ɑːɹ pˈɑːlɪθˌiːn ænd pˌɑːlɪpɹˈoʊpəlˌiːn, lˈaɪɾɚ ðɐn wˈɔːɾɚ; pˈiː vˈiː sˈiː sˈɪŋks.

lines.text: Buyers cap other plastics, and refuse PVC and metal.
lines.tts: Buyers cap other plastics, and refuse P V C and metal.
lines.phonemes: bˈaɪɚz kˈæp ˈʌðɚ plˈæstɪks, ænd ɹᵻfjˈuːz pˈiː vˈiː sˈiː ænd mˈɛɾəl.

lines.text: So sort floaters by their stamped number: 2 or 5.
lines.tts: So sort floaters by their stamped number: two or five.
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ sˈɔːɹt flˈoʊɾɚz baɪ ðɛɹ stˈæmpt nˈʌmbɚ: tˈuː ɔːɹ fˈaɪv.

lines.text: Sorted HDPE lists near ₹70 a kilo; mixed, ₹15 to ₹30.
lines.tts: Sorted H D P E lists near seventy rupees a kilo; mixed, fifteen to thirty.
lines.phonemes: sˈɔːɹɾᵻd ˈeɪtʃ dˈiː pˈiː ˈiː lˈɪsts nˌɪɹ sˈɛvənti ɹˈuːpiːz ɐ kˈiːloʊ; mˈɪkst, fˈɪftiːn tə θˈɜːɾi.

lines.text: That gap pays for sorting, cleaning and transport.
lines.phonemes: ðæt ɡˈæp pˈeɪz fɔːɹ sˈɔːɹɾɪŋ, klˈiːnɪŋ ænd tɹˈænspɔːɹt.

lines.text: Join WastePaisa and put your scrap to use.
lines.phonemes: dʒˈɔɪn wˈeɪst pˈaɪsɑː ænd pˌʊt jʊɹ skɹˈæp tə jˈuːz.
